title: Keeping Clear of Petty Company
note: The petty are those who say good has no good in it and evil no evil, with rakes, libertines and actors. Such a group twists the mind and ruins both worlds, so joining it undoes the help of the great.

couplets.plain: Greatness fears petty company. Pettiness treats it as kin.
couplets.pm: The nature of the great is to fear petty company. The nature of the petty is to settle on it as their kin the moment they join it. The wise fear it because they see how it would twist their understanding and the suffering that would follow. The unwise, being of one mind with it, look no further.

couplets.plain: Water changes and takes on the nature of the ground it meets. People’s understanding takes on the nature of their company.
couplets.pm: Water loses its own nature and takes on that of the ground it joins. In the same way, people’s understanding changes and takes on the nature of the group they join. In the sky water is itself, and on earth its colour and taste change. Alone, understanding is itself, and in a group its way of seeing changes.

links.quote: People’s understanding takes on the nature of their company
links.reason: States how company works: it changes understanding as the ground changes water.

links.quote: takes on the nature of their company
links.reason: Warns someone in a bad circle that their understanding will take on its nature.

couplets.plain: What a person perceives comes from their mind. What people call them comes from their company.
couplets.pm: Ordinary awareness comes from the mind. The word by which the world says “he is this sort of man” comes from his company. Bare sense perception is natural and needs no group. Being called good or bad rests on a finer, acquired understanding, and that needs one. This answers those who won’t accept the water comparison and say that change also comes from the mind.

links.quote: What people call them comes from their company

couplets.plain: A person’s understanding seems to be in their mind, but it lies in their company.
couplets.pm: This finer understanding shows itself as if it were in a person’s mind, but it lies in the group they have joined. Before you look closely it seems to be in the mind. When you look, it is in the company they have kept. It only appears in the mind, and its root is the group.

links.reason: Moves a person’s understanding out of the mind and into the company they keep.

couplets.plain: A pure mind and pure deeds both depend on pure company.
couplets.pm: Purity of mind, where finer understanding shows itself, and purity of deeds both come with pure company as their support. A pure mind is one freed from its natural ignorance. Pure deeds are good acts of speech and body. When your group is pure, long contact with it purifies your mind, understanding appears there, and your words and acts become pure.

couplets.plain: What the pure of mind leave behind is good. For those in pure company, no deed fails to turn out well.
couplets.pm: Those pure of mind are blessed with good children, because an effect doesn’t differ from its cause. For those whose company is pure, no undertaking fails to turn out well, because they think it through with good people before they act.
couplets.note: எச்சம் is what remains after you. He takes it as children.

links.quote: What the pure of mind leave behind is good
links.reason: Promises that what the pure of mind leave behind will be good.

links.quote: no deed fails to turn out well

couplets.plain: A good mind brings living beings prosperity. Good company brings every kind of glory.
couplets.pm: Goodness of mind gives people wealth, and goodness of company gives all renown along with it. Living beings here means humans. A good mind is itself righteousness, so it brings wealth, and only good people can bestow renown. This answers those who say people born with a good mind don’t need good company: it gives much besides, so they need it too.

links.quote: A good mind brings living beings prosperity
links.reason: Credits goodness of mind with the prosperity it brings.

links.quote: Good company brings every kind of glory

links.remove: The treasure image is the old English’s. The Tamil says a good mind brings prosperity, not that it is the true wealth.

couplets.plain: Even the noble, though their minds are thoroughly good, find protection in good company.
couplets.pm: Even when the noble have goodness of mind of their own through good deeds done before, good company gives it strength. Those past deeds may be there, yet good company goes on making the mind’s goodness grow.

links.reason: Even the noble, whose minds are good, find protection in good company.

couplets.plain: The next world comes from a good mind, and even that finds its protection in good company.
couplets.pm: Joy in the next world comes from goodness of mind. He grants the view that nothing else yields it. Even so, it draws strength from good company. If the mind slips now and then through the quality of dullness, good company steadies it and still brings the next world’s joy. So keeping away from petty company is praised here through seeking good company.

links.quote: finds its protection in good company
links.reason: Even the next world, which comes from a good mind, finds its protection in good company.

couplets.plain: There is no help greater than good company, and nothing causes more grief than bad company.
couplets.pm: No helper is greater than good company, and no enemy is greater than bad company. Good company draws you out of ignorance and keeps you from suffering, so it is a helper. Bad company draws you away from understanding and brings you suffering, so it is an enemy.

links.quote: no help greater than good company
nothing causes more grief than bad company
